svg.title: Fishmonger — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as fishmonger, wearing an apron and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A fish with a triangular tail rests above the pan and round dial of a compact weighing scale. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
